shows: K/K_ini for collisional ionization of H (RBED) with mean loss B + <ε>
from_scratch: trajectory K(t) from the rate registry; all rates re-implemented (see igm_losses)
from_library: numpy, scipy (solve_ivp Radau, quad, brentq, CubicSpline), astropy (Planck18), mpmath, matplotlib
choices: stop at R_H = 13.598 eV (D09, D21); between 13.598 and 13.6057 eV the ionization rate is zero, so K levels off at B and the event never fires (note on the figure)
